dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alice, I know you can hear me! I know you're spying on me from somewhere!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Unwilling to show yourself, huh? Is it 'cause you're scared? Or perhaps you can see you're wrong because of all the righteous allies by my side? You finally feel ashamed of everything you've done, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hah! Keep hiding and I'll... I'll... I'll come back tomorrow! Don't you forget, I'm not done with you yet!
